mission.title: Witness Protection
mission.description: Rescue two sabotage witnesses kidnapped by the imposter programs.

npc.say: These thugs are a menace to society!

phase.briefing: The mysterious imposter programs have kidnapped some of the human civilians who witnessed the recent hardline sabotage. Rescue one of these civilians and find out what they saw when the sabotage occurred.

enter.say: The sabotage witness, Rudolph Clark, is being held by the imposters inside that building. Wipe them out, save the witness, and find out what he saw when the hardline was sabotaged.

done.say: Now interrogate the witness regarding the hardline sabotage.

talk.say: You have to hurry and rescue my friend, Vennie Yeager! I didn't see this phone booth sabotage you're asking about, but I know that she did. They took her away to another location, but I managed to copy down the license number of their van as they drove off. Maybe you can trace it or something?
A second hostage? This bears investigating. Get the license number from him.

objective.text: Get the license number from Rudolph Clark

done.say: Here, I wrote the license number of the kidnappers on this envelope. Maybe you can use it to track them down?
We should be able to track the renegades by that license number.

objective.text: Do not let Rudolph Clark die

complete.say: Weird. The renegades left fewer programs than usual to guard that civilian.
Leave the building and wait for another update from me.

phase.briefing: We have located the second set of kidnappers. I am uploading their waypoint to you. Pursue and destroy them.

enter.say: We tracked the van used by the second group of kidnappers to that building; the kidnappers should be holding the second hostage, Vennie Yeager, inside. Rescue her, destroy the kidnappers, and find out what she knows about their hardline sabotage.

done.say: You've demolished all of the renegades in the area.

talk.say: Yeah, these same jerks were at the phone booth the other day, and they were doing something to it with these weird black box things.
That was the information we were after.

objective.text: Do not let Vennie Yeager die

complete.say: That's it -- you can get out of there now.

mission.finish: You did well to pursue this second set of kidnappers, {player}. This is not the first time that we've heard of these mysterious "black boxes" carried by the imposter programs during their sabotage attempts. This bears further investigation.
